cohort: The study included 200 primiparous women with a single pregnancy and cephalic presentation.
finding: Uterine contraction shapes change, and a higher F:R ratio was significantly associated with a lack of labor progress leading to cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: A higher F:R ratio and lower frequency of contractions were significantly associated with cesarean delivery due to lack of labor progress, compared to vaginal delivery.
cross-section timing: at the beginning of the active phase of labor (dilatation 3-5 cm)
